name: Gaetano
summary: Gaetano is named in 6 Parts of The Buildout, most recently Part 17: The Guarantee Has No Date. Argued in Part 6 (Scarcity as a warning), Part 8 (Real cash, real use), Part 11 (A backlog is a promise), Part 11 (Funded, not forecast), Part 11 (Voices that cross sides), Part 12 (The frontier is still paid), Part 16 (The loan is a bridge).

Gaetano counted on August 28 that customers outside the traditional hyperscalers, from neoclouds to sovereign clouds, produced 59% of Nvidia's data center growth that quarter.

The 59% that Gaetano counts outside the hyperscalers includes the neoclouds the seller's credit reaches, through commitments such as the $6.3 billion CoreWeave capacity order and the credit-support deals with AI clouds that Nvidia began pausing in August, though it also holds sovereign clouds and enterprises.
